Convert a Data Frame to a Named List of Vectors

Source: R/df2list.R
df2list.Rd

Convert a Data Frame to a Named List of Vectors

Usage

df2list(df, name_col, value_col, clean_names = FALSE)

Arguments

df

Data frame to be converted.

name_col

Character. Name of the column in df to be used for list names.

value_col

Character. Name of the column in df to be used as list elements (vectors).

clean_names

Logical. Should list names be modified to remove whitespaces and non-aphanumeric strings (excluding underscores)? See SomaDataIO::cleanNames() for more details.

Value

A list of vectors.

Author

Amanda Hiser

Examples

df <- SomaDataIO::rn2col(SomaDataIO::example_data, "Rowname")
df2list(df, name_col = "SampleType", value_col = "Rowname")
